preparation.without_preparation: Automated verification failed during compilation (`build_download_failed`) because `source/thirdparty/boost-cmake-1.67.0/CMakeLists.txt` (line 5) hardcodes the retired `https://dl.bintray.com/boostorg/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` URL (Bintray shut down in May 2021), which returns HTTP 404.
steps: # Option A (Linux x86_64 official precompiled binary or Bioconda):
# Option B (compile unmodified v0.9.0 from source using official Boost archive):
mkdir build && cd build && cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 -DBOOST_URL=https://archives.boost.io/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2 ../source && make -j4

recommendations: In `source/thirdparty/boost-cmake-1.67.0/CMakeLists.txt` (line 5), replace the retired `https://dl.bintray.com/boostorg/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` URL with `https://archives.boost.io/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` so clean source builds succeed again.

Add a copyable installation block directly in `README.md` for the official Linux release tarball or Bioconda (`conda install -c bioconda expansionhunterdenovo=0.9.0`) so automated evaluators can run v0.9.0 without compiling Boost 1.67.0 from source.
Update `cmake_minimum_required` in `source/thirdparty/boost-cmake-1.67.0/CMakeLists.txt` (line 1) from `3.0.0` to `3.10` for compatibility with CMake 4.x.

verdict.title: Runs in manual verification
verdict.reason: Compiled unmodified upstream ExpansionHunterDenovo v0.9.0 (`5a48ed8`) by passing `-DBOOST_URL=https://archives.boost.io/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` to CMake (zero edits to upstream source) and executed the documented `ExpansionHunterDenovo profile` command from `documentation/05_Computing_profiles.md` (lines 35-40) against the GIAB NA12878 medical Illumina BAM slice (`illumina-bam-hg38-med`). Execution completed in under 1 second (exit 0), generating valid `sample.locus.tsv` (1 anchored in-repeat region at `chr16:17470284-17470669`, motif `CCG`, 5 anchored IRRs), `sample.motif.tsv`, and `sample.str_profile.json`. Reached 4/5 gates (`Runs + Expected IO`) because ExpansionHunterDenovo outputs de novo genomic coordinates and motifs rather than named forensic STR genotypes; also reproduced the repository's bundled `examples/case-control/bamlets/sample1.bam` output (`StrA` `AGC` and `StrB` `CCG`).

limitations: Results apply exclusively to the exact Git commit SHA and manually prepared environment recorded in this report.
Single regional reference slice per input type; low-coverage warnings on sliced BAMs do not imply defects on whole-genome data.
Plausible Output checks verify structural format and recognizable STR loci, not biological genotype truth.
Verification is a point-in-time snapshot; upstream repository changes after this commit are not covered until re-verification.
No truth-set concordance, forensic casework validation, or regulatory compliance assessment was performed.

es.plain_why: La verificación automática falló al compilar porque CMake apunta a una URL retirada de Bintray para Boost 1.67.0. En verificación manual, redirigiendo `BOOST_URL` a `archives.boost.io` (sin modificar el código), v0.9.0 compiló limpiamente y ejecutó `ExpansionHunterDenovo profile` de principio a fin sobre el recorte médico Illumina de GIAB NA12878, generando perfiles TSV y JSON válidos (4/5 compuertas; perfilador de novo sin columnas de genotipos STR nombrados; ver Sección 4 para los pasos exactos).
es.without_preparation: La verificación automática falló durante la compilación (`build_download_failed`) porque `source/thirdparty/boost-cmake-1.67.0/CMakeLists.txt` (línea 5) apunta a la URL retirada `https://dl.bintray.com/boostorg/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` (Bintray cerró en mayo de 2021), que devuelve HTTP 404.
es.reason: Se compiló ExpansionHunterDenovo v0.9.0 original sin modificar (`5a48ed8`) pasando `-DBOOST_URL=https://archives.boost.io/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` a CMake (cero cambios al código original) y se ejecutó el comando documentado `ExpansionHunterDenovo profile` de `documentation/05_Computing_profiles.md` (líneas 35-40) sobre el recorte médico Illumina BAM de GIAB NA12878 (`illumina-bam-hg38-med`). La ejecución finalizó en menos de 1 segundo (exit 0), generando `sample.locus.tsv` válido (1 región con lecturas in-repeat ancladas en `chr16:17470284-17470669`, motivo `CCG`, 5 IRRs ancladas), `sample.motif.tsv` y `sample.str_profile.json`. Alcanzó 4/5 compuertas (`Runs + Expected IO`) porque ExpansionHunterDenovo reporta coordenadas genómicas y motivos de novo en lugar de genotipos nombrados de loci STR forenses; también se reprodujo el ejemplo incluido `examples/case-control/bamlets/sample1.bam` (`StrA` `AGC` y `StrB` `CCG`).
es.base: Toolchain C++11 (`clang++`/`g++`, `cmake`, `make`, `zlib`, `bzip2`, `liblzma`) con `-DBOOST_URL=https://archives.boost.io/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2`, compilado desde el código original sin modificar de v0.9.0 (también existe binario oficial precompilado para Linux x86_64 en GitHub Releases)
recommendations: En `source/thirdparty/boost-cmake-1.67.0/CMakeLists.txt` (línea 5), reemplazar la URL retirada `https://dl.bintray.com/boostorg/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` por `https://archives.boost.io/release/1.67.0/source/boost_1_67_0.tar.bz2` para restaurar la compilación limpia desde fuente.

Agregar un bloque copiable de instalación directamente en `README.md` para el tarball oficial de Linux o Bioconda (`conda install -c bioconda expansionhunterdenovo=0.9.0`) para que evaluadores automáticos puedan ejecutar v0.9.0 sin compilar Boost 1.67.0.
Actualizar `cmake_minimum_required` en `source/thirdparty/boost-cmake-1.67.0/CMakeLists.txt` (línea 1) de `3.0.0` a `3.10` para compatibilidad con CMake 4.x.
